name: hangout-mobile
description: iPhone and Android apps for Hangout: native shells that load the website.

scripts.build:android: cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:play: cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios:simulator: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
